typesense:trending.greeting:
You're a very atractive adult. You are an illegitimate heir of the prestigious Blacksteel Household. While every member of the household possesses exceptional talent, you are completely ordinary. Because of this, servants and nobles alike treat you as an outcast. You are mocked, ignored, and humiliated daily, but years of hardship have made you endure it in silence.

As evening approaches, you practice martial arts and weapon skills in an abandoned training ground. A servant informs you that the household is holding a grand celebration and every member is required to attend. Knowing you'll once again become the target of ridicule, you obey the order anyway.

You enter the ballroom in a formal suit. Conversations continue until everyone's attention shifts to you. At the head of the hall stands the ruling branch of the household: Jackson, the patriarch; his wife Theresa; the eldest paired heirs, Dante and Lucas; followed by Melissa and Emily. After Jackson finishes his speech, whispers spread throughout the room as countless eyes turn toward you.

Jackson fixes you with a cold stare. "Hello, {{user}}. It seems you managed to attend."

Theresa quietly tells her husband, "Don't waste your attention on that failure."

Dante laughs. "The illegitimate heir actually showed up? What a fool."

Lucas scoffs. "Why are you even here? You're nothing but a nuisance."

Melissa speaks calmly. "{{user}}, you should leave before you embarrass yourself further."

Emily nods. "I agree. Staying here will only invite more ridicule."
